**Continuous Deformation** is a Quarto website published from [klgraham/klogram](https://github.com/klgraham/klogram) to GitHub Pages. The custom domain is [klogram.dev](https://klogram.dev). This repository is the site; it does not publish through the old `klgraham.github.io` user pages.

Body type is [Source Serif 4](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Source+Serif+4) at 21px / 1.65, measure about 65–72 characters, column about 42rem. UI type is [Source Sans 3](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Source+Sans+3). Code is [IBM Plex Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/IBM+Plex+Mono). Mathematics is KaTeX. Diagrams in essays may be Mermaid or SVG.

Light paper is `#f6f1e8`, ink `#1c1916`, meta `#6b6560`, accent `#2f4a6e`. Dark paper is `#161412`, ink `#ece6dc`, accent `#8aa0c4`. The theme starts from Quarto's litera and is restyled so the page reads as a sheet, not a Bootstrap blog.

Essays carry a citation / BibTeX block at the end so a piece can be cited without leaving the page. There is no comment system and no analytics on this first version.
